import hashlib

    result = subprocess.run(runner, cwd=directory, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)

            self.assertFalse(target.with_name(target.name + '.pending').exists(), 'pending file must be removed')
            with target.open('rb') as destination:
